map.不一定。账面价值可能含商誉、存货减值风险，或行业已衰退。需结合 ROE、资产质量: Not necessarily. Book value may include goodwill, carry inventory impairment risk, or the industry may already be in decline. Judge it together with ROE and asset quality to avoid a "value trap".
map.互为倒数：P/B = 1/(B/M)。P/B<1 ⇔ B/M>1（市值低于账面）: They are reciprocals: P/B = 1/(B/M). P/B<1 ⇔ B/M>1 (market value below book value).
map.价值投资策略筛选（低 P/B = 高 B/M 多为价值股）。: Value strategy screening (a low P/B = high B/M is often a value stock).
